append_text_to_image: append lines of text onto a numpy image array using OpenCV with left and right column wrapping
overlay_frame: overlay flattened info dictionary key-value pairs as text onto a video frame image
append_text_two_column_layout: render text lines in a two-column layout on an image switching to the right column when the left is full
overlay_frame_with_additional: overlay frame info with additional custom text lines appended to the flattened dictionary entries
text_overlay_with_font_sizing: overlay text on an image with configurable font size and automatic thickness for outline and fill
